text_block_list.name: Bookstore Clerk
text_block_list.text: Oh, that's actually secretly super popular right now~! They say it's this year's absolute best pure-love youth romance!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
(Such delicate, fresh brushwork...
Descriptions so rich in emotion, I can practically smell the wind...)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: (How beautiful the world appears when seen through the protagonist's eyes...)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: I never would've thought... it was a tragic love story...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There was touching emotion, but dazed by grief,
training ended up being skipped entirely...
